reuse.why: Takes its categories from the shared getMonthActionCategories and registers through the usual mutator(undoable(...)) path, but computes last month's spending with its own transactions SQL instead of reading the per-month sum-amount-<category> sheet cell the averages already use.

duplication.why: It repeats the per-site income check and the expense sign flip that the other month-wide actions write inline, and its SQL re-derives a per-category monthly total the budget sheet already maintains.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings; a raw transactions aggregation in the actions layer is out of keeping with how the other actions read sheet values.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Category selection stays shared, but a second definition of a category's monthly spending (own offbudget and alive-transaction filtering) can drift from the sheet's sum-amount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setLastMonthSpending queries v_transactions_internal_alive directly instead of using the sheet's sum-amount-<category> value (via getSheetValue) that getCategoryAverage reads.

disguised_duplication.where: The monthly spending total that the sheet's sum-amount cell provides is re-derived as a GROUP BY SQL query in setLastMonthSpending.
